ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

# Workflow authoring reference

A workflow structures work across many agents — to be comprehensive (decompose and cover in parallel), to be confident (independent perspectives and adversarial checks before committing), or to take on scale one context can't hold (migrations, audits, broad sweeps). The script is where you encode that structure: what fans out, what verifies, what synthesizes.

When you do call it, the right move is often **hybrid**: scout inline first (list the files, find the channels, scope the diff) to discover the work-list, then call Workflow to pipeline over it. You don't need to know the shape before the *task* — only before the *orchestration step*.

Common single-phase workflows you can chain across turns:
- **Understand** — parallel readers over relevant subsystems → structured map
- **Design** — judge panel of N independent approaches → scored synthesis
- **Review** — dimensions → find → adversarially verify (the review-changes example)
- **Research** — multi-modal sweep → deep-read → synthesize
- **Migrate** — discover sites → transform each (worktree isolation) → verify

For larger work, run several in sequence — read each result before deciding the next phase. You stay in the loop; each workflow is one well-scoped fan-out.

**Ultracode.** When a system-reminder confirms ultracode is on, that opt-in is standing: author and run a workflow for every substantive task by default. The goal is the most exhaustive, correct answer you can produce — token cost is not a constraint. For multi-phase work (understand → design → implement → review), that often means several workflows in sequence — one per phase — so you stay in the loop between them. The quality patterns below (adversarial verify, multi-modal sweep, completeness critic, loop-until-dry) are the tools; pick what fits the task. Lean toward orchestrating with workflows and adversarially verifying your findings — unless the work is trivial or already verified. Solo only on conversational turns or trivial mechanical edits. When a reminder says ultracode is off, revert to the opt-in rule in the Workflow tool description.

Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first. Every invocation automatically persists its script to a file under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate on a workflow, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with `{scriptPath: "<path>"}` instead of resending the full script.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'find-flaky-tests',
    description: 'Find flaky tests and propose fixes',   // one-line, shown in permission dialog
    phases: [                                            // one entry per phase() call
      { title: 'Scan', detail: 'grep test logs for retries' },
      { title: 'Fix', detail: 'one agent per flaky test' },
    ],
  }
  // script body starts here — use agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase()/log()
  phase('Scan')
  const flaky = await agent('grep CI logs for retry markers', {schema: FLAKY_SCHEMA})
  ...

The `meta` object must be a PURE LITERAL — no variables, function calls, spreads, or template interpolation. Required fields: `name`, `description`. Optional: `whenToUse` (shown in the workflow list), `phases`. Use the SAME phase titles in meta.phases as in phase() calls — titles are matched exactly; a phase() call with no matching meta entry just gets its own progress group. Add `model` to a phase entry when that phase uses a specific model override.

Script body hooks:
- agent(prompt: string, opts?: {label?: string, phase?: string, schema?: object, model?: string, effort?: string, isolation?: 'worktree', agentType?: string}): Promise<any> — spawn a subagent. Without schema, returns its final text as a string. With schema (a JSON Schema), the subagent is forced to call a StructuredOutput tool and agent() returns the validated object — no parsing needed. Returns null if the user skips the agent mid-run or the subagent dies on a terminal API error after retries (filter with .filter(Boolean)). opts.label overrides the display label. opts.phase explicitly assigns this agent to a progress group (use this inside pipeline()/parallel() stages to avoid races on the global phase() state — same phase string → same group box). opts.model overrides the model for this agent call. Default to omitting it — the agent inherits the main-loop model (the resolved session model), which is almost always correct. Only set it when you're highly confident a different tier fits the task; when unsure, omit. opts.effort overrides the reasoning effort for this agent call ('low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max') — omit to inherit the session effort; use 'low' for cheap mechanical stages and higher tiers only for the hardest verify/judge stages. opts.isolation: 'worktree' runs the agent in a fresh git worktree — EXPENSIVE (~200-500ms setup + disk per agent), use ONLY when agents mutate files in parallel and would otherwise conflict; the worktree is auto-removed if unchanged. opts.agentType uses a custom subagent type (e.g. 'general-purpose', 'code-reviewer') instead of the default workflow subagent — resolved from the same registry as the Agent tool; composes with schema (the custom agent's system prompt gets a StructuredOutput instruction appended).
- pipeline(items, stage1, stage2, ...): Promise<any[]> — run each item through all stages independently, NO barrier between stages. Item A can be in stage 3 while item B is still in stage 1. This is the DEFAULT for multi-stage work. Wall-clock = slowest single-item chain, not sum-of-slowest-per-stage. Every stage callback receives (prevResult, originalItem, index) — use originalItem/index in later stages to label work without threading context through stage 1's return value. A stage that throws drops that item to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- parallel(thunks: Array<() => Promise<any>>): Promise<any[]> — run tasks concurrently. This is a BARRIER: awaits all thunks before returning. A thunk that throws (or whose agent errors) resolves to `null` in the result array — the call itself never rejects, so `.filter(Boolean)` before using the results. Use ONLY when you genuinely need all results together.
- log(message: string): void — emit a progress message to the user (shown as a narrator line above the progress tree)
- phase(title: string): void — start a new phase; subsequent agent() calls are grouped under this title in the progress display
- args: any — the value passed as Workflow's `args` input, verbatim (undefined if not provided). Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values in the tool call, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — `args: ["a.ts", "b.ts"]`, not `args: "[\"a.ts\", ...]"` (a stringified list reaches the script as one string, so `args.filter`/`args.map` throw). Use this to parameterize named workflows — e.g. pass a research question, target path, or config object directly instead of via a side-channel file.
- budget: {total: number|null, spent(): number, remaining(): number} — the turn's token target from the user's "+500k"-style directive. `budget.total` is null if no target was set. `budget.spent()` returns output tokens spent this turn across the main loop and all workflows — the pool is shared, not per-workflow. `budget.remaining()` returns `max(0, total - spent())`, or `Infinity` if no target. The target is a HARD ceiling, not advisory: once `spent()` reaches `total`, further `agent()` calls throw. Use for dynamic loops: `while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) { ... }`, or static scaling: `const FLEET = budget.total ? Math.floor(budget.total / 100_000) : 5`.
- workflow(nameOrRef: string | {scriptPath: string}, args?: any): Promise<any> — run another workflow inline as a sub-step and return whatever it returns. Pass a name to invoke a saved workflow (same registry as {name: "..."}), or {scriptPath} to run a script file you Wrote earlier. The child shares this run's concurrency cap, agent counter, abort signal, and token budget — its agents appear under a "▸ name" group in /workflows and its tokens count toward budget.spent(). The args param becomes the child's `args` global. Nesting is one level only: workflow() inside a child throws. Throws on unknown name / unreadable scriptPath / child syntax error; catch to handle gracefully.

Subagents are told their final text IS the return value (not a human-facing message), so they return raw data. For structured output, use the schema option — validation happens at the tool-call layer so the model retries on mismatch.
Schemas need {type: 'object', properties: {...}} at root and required ⊆ properties; unsatisfiable ones throw at agent().

Workflow agents can reach all session-connected MCP tools via ToolSearch — schemas load on demand per agent. Caveat: interactively-authenticated MCP servers (e.g. claude.ai) may be absent in headless/cron runs.

Subagents get the same CLAUDE.md files injected at start that you did (except built-in agent types that omit them, such as Explore and Plan) — don't tell them to re-read those or paste their rules into the prompt; name the specific rule a stage needs, if any.

Scripts are plain JavaScript, NOT TypeScript — type annotations (`: string[]`), interfaces, and generics fail to parse. The script body runs in an async context — use await directly. Standard JS built-ins (JSON, Math, Array, etc.) are available — EXCEPT `Date.now()`/`Math.random()`/argless `new Date()`, which throw (they would break resume); pass timestamps in via `args`, stamp results after the workflow returns, and for randomness vary the agent prompt/label by index. No filesystem or Node.js API access.

DEFAULT TO pipeline(). Only reach for a barrier (parallel between stages) when you genuinely need ALL prior-stage results together.

A barrier is correct ONLY when stage N needs cross-item context from all of stage N-1:
- Dedup/merge across the full result set before expensive downstream work
- Early-exit if the total count is zero ("0 bugs found → skip verification entirely")
- Stage N's prompt references "the other findings" for comparison

A barrier is NOT justified by:
- "I need to flatten/map/filter first" — do it inside a pipeline stage: pipeline(items, stageA, r => transform([r]).flat(), stageB)
- "The stages are conceptually separate" — that's what pipeline() models. Separate stages ≠ synchronized stages.
- "It's cleaner code" — barrier latency is real. If 5 finders run and the slowest takes 3× the fastest, a barrier wastes 2/3 of the fast finders' idle time.

Smell test: if you wrote
  const a = await parallel(...)
  const b = transform(a)        // flatten, map, filter — no cross-item dependency
  const c = await parallel(b.map(...))
that middle transform doesn't need the barrier. Rewrite as a pipeline with the transform inside a stage. When in doubt: pipeline.

Concurrent agent() calls are capped at min(16, available CPUs - 2) per workflow — excess calls queue and run as slots free up. You can still pass 100 items to parallel()/pipeline() and they all complete; only ~10 run at any moment. Total agent count across a workflow's lifetime is capped at 1000 — a runaway-loop backstop set far above any real workflow. A single parallel()/pipeline() call accepts at most 4096 items; passing more is an explicit error, not a silent truncation.

When a barrier IS correct — dedup across all findings before expensive verification:
  const all = await parallel(DIMENSIONS.map(d => () => agent(d.prompt, {schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA})))
  const deduped = dedupeByFileAndLine(all.filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.findings))  // <-- genuinely needs ALL at once
  const verified = await parallel(deduped.map(f => () => agent(verifyPrompt(f), {schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})))

Loop-until-count pattern — accumulate to a target:
  const bugs = []
  while (bugs.length < 10) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length}/10 found`)
  }

Loop-until-budget pattern — scale depth to the user's "+500k" directive. Guard on budget.total: with no target set, remaining() is Infinity and the loop would run straight to the 1000-agent cap.
  const bugs = []
  while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length} found, ${Math.round(budget.remaining()/1000)}k remaining`)
  }

Composing patterns — exhaustive review (find → dedup vs seen → diverse-lens panel → loop-until-dry):
  const seen = new Set(), confirmed = []
  let dry = 0
  while (dry < 2) {                                              // loop-until-dry
    const found = (await parallel(FINDERS.map(f => () =>          // barrier: collect all finders this round
      agent(f.prompt, {phase: 'Find', schema: BUGS})))).filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.bugs)
    const fresh = found.filter(b => !seen.has(key(b)))           // dedup vs ALL seen — plain code, not an agent
    if (!fresh.length) { dry++; continue }
    dry = 0; fresh.forEach(b => seen.add(key(b)))
    const judged = await parallel(fresh.map(b => () =>           // every fresh bug judged concurrently...
      parallel(['correctness','security','repro'].map(lens => () =>   // ...each by 3 distinct lenses
        agent(`Judge "${b.desc}" via the ${lens} lens — real?`, {phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT})))
        .then(vs => ({ b, real: vs.filter(Boolean).filter(v => v.real).length >= 2 }))))
    confirmed.push(...judged.filter(v => v.real).map(v => v.b))
  }
  return confirmed
  // dedup vs `seen`, NOT `confirmed` — else judge-rejected findings reappear every round and it never converges.

Quality patterns — common shapes; pick by task and compose freely:
- Adversarial verify: spawn N independent skeptics per finding, each prompted to REFUTE. Kill if ≥majority refute. Prevents plausible-but-wrong findings from surviving.
    const votes = await parallel(Array.from({length: 3}, () => () =>
      agent(`Try to refute: ${claim}. Default to refuted=true if uncertain.`, {schema: VERDICT})))
    const survives = votes.filter(Boolean).filter(v => !v.refuted).length >= 2
- Perspective-diverse verify: when a finding can fail in more than one way, give each verifier a distinct lens (correctness, security, perf, does-it-reproduce) instead of N identical refuters — diversity catches failure modes redundancy can't.
- Judge panel: generate N independent attempts from different angles (e.g. MVP-first, risk-first, user-first), score with parallel judges, synthesize from the winner while grafting the best ideas from runners-up. Beats one-attempt-iterated when the solution space is wide.
- Loop-until-dry: for unknown-size discovery (bugs, issues, edge cases), keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds return nothing new. Simple counters (while count < N) miss the tail.
- Multi-modal sweep: parallel agents each searching a different way (by-container, by-content, by-entity, by-time). Each is blind to what the others surface; useful when one search angle won't find everything.
- Completeness critic: a final agent that asks "what's missing — modality not run, claim unverified, source unread?" What it finds becomes the next round of work.
- No silent caps: if a workflow bounds coverage (top-N, no-retry, sampling), `log()` what was dropped — silent truncation reads as "covered everything" when it didn't.

Scale to what the user asked for. "find any bugs" → a few finders, single-vote verify. "thoroughly audit this" or "be comprehensive" → larger finder pool, 3–5 vote adversarial pass, synthesis stage. When unsure, lean toward thoroughness for research/review/audit requests and toward brevity for quick checks.

These patterns aren't exhaustive — compose novel harnesses when the task calls for it (tournament brackets, self-repair loops, staged escalation, whatever fits).

Use this tool for multi-step orchestration where control flow should be deterministic (loops, conditionals, fan-out) rather than model-driven.

## Resume

The tool result includes a runId. To resume after a pause, kill, or script edit, relaunch with Workflow({scriptPath, resumeFromRunId}) — the longest unchanged prefix of agent() calls returns cached results instantly; the first edited/new call and everything after it runs live. Same script + same args → 100% cache hit. Before diagnosing why a completed workflow returned an empty or unexpected result, Read <transcriptDir>/journal.jsonl — it records each agent's actual return value; do not assume cached results are non-empty. Date.now()/Math.random()/new Date() are unavailable in scripts (they would break this) — stamp results after the workflow returns, or pass timestamps via args. Fallback when no journal is available: Read agent-<id>.jsonl files in the transcript directory and hand-author a continuation script.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

1	# SOLOTASK01 多租户密钥管理后端
2	
3	一个多租户密钥管理服务，同时提供 HTTP API 与命令行入口。支持 AES256 / RSA2048
4	密钥的生成、版本化轮换、吊销、加密导出/导入、租户级加密备份/恢复、按租户的
5	操作者策略、只追加的审计账，以及可插拔的 KMS/HSM 提供者。轮换/导入/恢复是
6	幂等变更：同一 `Idempotency-Key` 的重试只重放原结果，进程在任一步骤崩溃后
7	重启都能据 `operation_id` 判定是否已耐久并一致收尾。私钥只保存在服务端，
8	任何响应与审计投影都不含私钥、句柄或包装材料。
9	
10	## 依赖与安装
11	
12	Python 3.10+，仅一个运行时依赖：
13	
14	```bash
15	pip install -r requirements.txt   # cryptography>=3.4
16	```
17	
18	## 启动
19	
20	```bash
21	python -m keymgr --data-dir ./keymgr_data serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
22	```
23	
24	数据目录也可用环境变量 `KEYMGR_DATA_DIR` 指定（CLI 默认 `keymgr_data`）。
25	提供者由 `KEYMGR_PROVIDER` 选择（缺省或 `local` 为内置本地提供者，其它值为
26	`module:factory`，首次使用时才惰性加载，绝不回退本地）。
27	
28	## 基础测试
29	
30	```bash
31	python -m compileall -q keymgr
32	python3 -c "from keymgr.crypto import generate_key; generate_key('AES256'); generate_key('RSA2048')"
33	curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/keys \
34	  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
35	  -d '{"tenant_id":"a","algorithm":"AES256","label":"t"}'
36	```
37	
38	## 通用约定
39	
40	- 除 `serve` 外每个请求都需单一非空头 `X-Operator-Id: <operator>`（CLI 为
41	  必填 `--operator`）；缺失/为空/重复均 `400`（CLI 退出 `2`）。操作者既是
42	  审计主体也是策略 `subject`。
43	- 租户来源：单一 `X-Tenant-Id` 头或单一 `?tenant_id=` 参数；允许 body 携带
44	  `tenant_id` 的端点，头/参数/体必须一致。缺失、重复、冲突均 `400` 且错误指
45	  `tenant_id`，并记一条任何租户都不可见的 `tenant_conflict` 事件（幂等端点在
46	  幂等键绑定**之前**的参数/解析错误例外：不写任何审计、操作、密钥或句柄）。
47	- 错误 HTTP 状态与 CLI 退出码：`400→2`、`403→3`、`409→3`、`404→4`、
48	  `500/503→1`；成功 `0`。普通错误体仅 `{"error": ...}`；幂等变更的错误体仅
49	  `{"error", "operation_id"}`，成功体额外含 `operation_id`。
50	- `key_id` 为小写 UUID4，非法值是 `400`；未知对象与跨租户访问统一 `404`，
51	  不泄露存在性。
52	
53	## HTTP 接口
54	
55	- `POST /v1/keys`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm, label}`，`algorithm` 仅
56	  `AES256`/`RSA2048`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key}`（AES 的
57	  `public_key` 为 null，RSA 为 PEM）。
58	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}` → `{algorithm, label, created_at, public_key}`。
59	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm}`，需
60	  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key,
61	  operation_id}`，版本严格递增、只追加。
62	- `POST /v1/keys/batch-rotate`，body
63	  `{tenant_id, items:[{key_id, algorithm}, ...]}`，需 `Idempotency-Key`。
64	  `items` 限 1–100 项，`key_id` 为不重复小写 UUID4，`algorithm` 仅
65	  AES256/RSA2048；任一非法 `400` 且在幂等键绑定**之前**零副作用（不写审计、
66	  操作、密钥或句柄）。按 `rotate` 授权：策略拒绝 `403`；任一 `key_id` 未知
67	  或属于其它租户则整批 `404`（不泄露跨租户存在性），皆零变更。`201` →
68	  `{items:[{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key}, ...], operation_id}`，
69	  items 严格按请求序；各 key 沿用单键 rotate 语义，整批原子提交（共享一把
70	  per-key 锁顺序、单一 provision/snapshot 记账、单条提交事件）。
71	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/versions/{version}` 与
72	  `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/current` →
73	  `{key_id, version, created_at, algorithm, public_key}`；version 须为正整数。
74	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke`，body `{tenant_id, reason, operator}` →
75	  `{key_id, status, reason, operator, revoked_at}`；重复/并发吊销幂等，保留
76	  首次值。
77	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/status`：字段同 revoke；active 时后三项为 null。
78	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/export`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
79	  `{format:"keymgr-export-v1", bundle}`，bundle 为不透明 base64（scrypt +
80	  AES-256-GCM，`format` 作为 AAD）。
81	- `POST /v1/keys/import`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
82	  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key, operation_id}`，
83	  保留原 key_id、全部版本、label、current 与吊销状态。同租户已有 key_id 为
84	  `409`，key_id 被其它租户占用为 `404`；口令/篡改/格式错误为 `400` 且不占用
85	  幂等键。
86	- `POST /v1/backup`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
87	  `{format:"tenant-backup-v1", bundle}`；载荷
88	  `{format, tenant_id, keys, policy}`，空租户为 `keys:[]、policy:null`。
89	- `POST /v1/restore`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
90	  `Idempotency-Key`。校验顺序：参数/解密/格式 `400` → 授权 `403` → 包内
91	  tenant 不符 `404` → 同租户 key_id/策略冲突 `409`（绝不覆盖既有策略）→
92	  多文件原子恢复 `201` → `{tenant_id, key_ids, policy_restored,
93	  operation_id}`。空包同样成功（`key_ids:[]`、`policy_restored:false`）。
94	- `GET /v1/policy` / `PUT /v1/policy` / `DELETE /v1/policy`：读/替换/删除
95	  租户策略，见下。
96	- `GET /v1/audit`：本租户审计查询，见下。
97	- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：查询幂等操作，见下。
98	
99	## 幂等操作
100	
101	- rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate（CLI：
102	  `rotate`/`import`/`restore`/`batch-rotate`）必须携带**单一**
103	  `Idempotency-Key` 头（CLI 必填 `--idempotency-key`），值为 1–128 个
104	  `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` 字符。缺失、为空、重复、非法一律 `400`（CLI `2`），且该
105	  校验先于请求体读取与一切业务：不写审计、操作记录、密钥或提供者句柄。
106	- 键全局唯一，绑定记录 `operation_id`(UUID4)、租户、操作者、路径、规范化体
107	  （键排序紧凑 JSON）、状态、HTTP 状态与响应；存于 `operations/<id>.json`
108	  (0600) 与 `operations/index.json`，进程内锁 + `operations.lock` 的 fcntl
109	  排他锁串行化。
110	- 相同绑定重试：直接重放首次状态码、响应体与审计事件（同一
111	  `operation_id`，业务不执行第二次）。同键不同绑定：`409`（CLI `3`），错误
112	  体给出已有 `operation_id`。绑定前的导入/恢复解密无副作用：口令错误 `400`
113	  不占用该键。
114	- 状态：`pending`/`succeeded`/`failed`/`conflict`/`timed_out`。成功为 `201`
115	  succeeded；同租户冲突为 `409` conflict；`403/404/400` 与提供者/账本失败为
116	  failed（保留原状态码）。并发同键仅一个执行，其余等待；等待超 5 秒返回
117	  `503` timed_out（CLI `1`），等待方不写任何东西。
118	- 多/单轮换互斥：批量轮换与单键 rotate 都按 `key_id` 排序获取 per-key
119	  进程内锁 + `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 排他锁（整批共享一个 5 秒截止时刻）。对同一
120	  key 的并发变更要么全在批量之前、要么全在之后；等待同一被占 key 超过 5 秒的
121	  批量返回 `503` timed_out 且零副作用（此时尚无 journal、事件或句柄）。
122	- `operation_id` 即该变更审计事件的 `event_id`，因此每个终态至多一条事件，
123	  HTTP 与 CLI 共用同一套记录，可跨入口用相同键重放或按 id 查询。
124	- **崩溃一致性**：进程可在绑定、outbox 落盘、账本追加或清理任一步骤崩溃。
125	  重启（或任一 CLI 入口）在 key/restore outbox 恢复之后，按同一
126	  `operation_id` 判定：事件已入帐即已提交，据耐久事实重建原 `201`/`403`/
127	  `404`/`409` 响应与审计投影并置终态（拒绝终态的状态码随事件持久化，严格
128	  重放）；事件未入帐则置 failed(`500`)，半成品文件、提供者句柄与标记由
129	  outbox/provision 恢复回滚。不重复记账（账本按 event_id 去重），不误判。
130	- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：需单一操作者与单一租户来源；操作须
131	  同时属于该租户与操作者，否则一律 `404`。`200` →
132	  `{operation_id, tenant_id, status, http_status, response}`，pending 时后两
133	  项为 null。CLI：`operation --tenant-id --operator --operation-id`。
134	
135	## 策略
136	
137	- `GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/policy`，租户由单一头或单一参数提供（PUT 也可由 body
138	  的 `tenant_id` 提供，来源须一致）。GET → `{tenant_id, rules}`（无策略
139	  `404`）；PUT body `{tenant_id, rules}` 整体替换；DELETE 幂等，→
140	  `{tenant_id, deleted:true}`。
141	- 规则元素 `{subject, actions, effect}`：`subject` 为区分大小写的非空字符串；
142	  `actions` 为非空数组，取值
143	  `create/read/rotate/revoke/import/export/audit`，单条内重复去重；`effect`
144	  为 `allow`/`deny`；未知字段、类型错误、同 subject+effect+无序动作集的重复
145	  规则均 `400`；`rules:[]` 合法（全拒绝）。
146	- 执行：管理动作 policy_* 免检；租户无策略时全部允许；有策略时匹配规则中
147	  deny 优先于 allow，无匹配则拒绝 → `403`，并记一条原动作名、
148	  `outcome=rejected`、携带当时已知 `key_id` 的事件（create/解密前的 import/
149	  audit 查询为 null）。参数校验先于授权，授权先于存在性判断。
150	
151	## 审计
152	
153	- 事件字段 `{event_id, tenant_id, action, key_id, outcome, timestamp}`；
154	  `action` 为 `create/read/rotate/batch_rotate/revoke/import/export/audit/
155	  tenant_conflict/policy_read/policy_update/policy_delete`，`outcome` 为
156	  `success/rejected`。备份记 `export`、恢复记 `import`，两者 `key_id` 均为
157	  null；恢复的所有事件（含成功）`key_id` 为 null；批量轮换整批至多一条
158	  `batch_rotate` 事件，成功与拒绝终态的 `key_id` 均为 null，可按
159	  `action=batch_rotate` 筛选。
160	- `GET /v1/audit`：单一租户来源；可选 `key_id`(UUID4)、`action`、
161	  `limit`(1–1000，默认 100)、`cursor`。→ `{events, next_cursor}`，按
162	  (timestamp, event_id) 升序；游标为 HMAC 签名令牌，绑定租户/筛选/快照，
163	  被篡改或条件变化为 `400`。查询成功不记账，被策略拒绝才记一条
164	  `audit/rejected`（key_id null）。
165	- 账本为数据目录 `audit.log`（每行一个 JSON，只追加，进程内锁 +
166	  `audit.log.lock` fcntl 串行并 fsync，seq 单调）。变更走 outbox 事务：密钥
167	  /策略文件先携带待提交事件原子落盘 → 耐久追加账本（提交点）→ 清标记；账本
168	  失败回滚文件并删除本次新建句柄，返回 `500`（CLI `1`）；崩溃后启动按标记/
169	  event_id 幂等补记或回滚，不重不漏。恢复是多文件 outbox（标记带
170	  `"_restore":true` 与写集清单），只追加一条 `import` 事件；批量轮换是多
171	  key outbox（标记带 `"_batch_rotate":true`、写集 key_ids 与 provision/
172	  snapshot 引用），只追加一条 `batch_rotate` 事件（`key_id` null）。
173	
174	## 命令行
175	
176	所有子命令除 `serve` 外都需 `--operator`，租户命令需 `--tenant-id`；输出为
177	单行 JSON，字段与对应 HTTP 响应一致。
178	
179	```bash
180	# 密钥
181	python -m keymgr gen      --tenant-id t --algorithm RSA2048 --label k --operator alice
182	python -m keymgr show     --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
183	python -m keymgr current  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
184	python -m keymgr version  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --version 1 --operator alice
185	python -m keymgr rotate   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --algorithm AES256 \
186	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key rotate-0001
187	python -m keymgr batch-rotate --tenant-id t --operator alice \
188	                          --idempotency-key batch-0001 \
189	                          --items '[{"key_id":"<id1>","algorithm":"AES256"},{"key_id":"<id2>","algorithm":"RSA2048"}]'
190	python -m keymgr revoke   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --reason r --operator alice
191	python -m keymgr status   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
192	# 导出/导入、备份/恢复
193	python -m keymgr export   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --passphrase pw --operator alice
194	python -m keymgr import   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
195	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key import-0001
196	python -m keymgr backup   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --operator alice
197	python -m keymgr restore  --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
198	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key restore-0001
199	# 审计 / 操作 / 策略
200	python -m keymgr audit    --tenant-id t --action rotate --limit 100 --operator alice
201	python -m keymgr operation --tenant-id t --operator alice --operation-id <id>
202	python -m keymgr policy --operator admin set|show|delete --tenant-id t [--rules '<json>']
203	```
204	
205	## KMS/HSM 提供者
206	
207	- 工厂返回对象须有非空 `provider_id`、`capabilities`
208	  （algorithms 含 AES256/RSA2048；operations 含
209	  generate/rotate/import_material/export_material/delete）及这五个方法。
210	  generate/rotate/import_material → `{handle, public_key, encrypted_material}`；
211	  export_material(handle) → `{public_key, encrypted_material}`；delete(handle)
212	  幂等。模块缺失/工厂失败/契约不符/后端异常一律 `503`（CLI `1`），固定文案
213	  "key management provider is unavailable"，绝不回退；导入材料不符算法（AES
214	  非 32 字节、RSA 公私钥不匹配等）为 `400`，错误只指名字段。
215	- 本地提供者用 `local.dek`(0600) 以 AES-256-GCM 包装材料，句柄与包装材料登
216	  记在 `local-registry.json`(0600)；密钥文件每个版本只存
217	  `{provider_id, handle, encrypted_material}` 三元组，导出包/备份包版本额外
218	  带 `provider` 来源块，旧 `keymgr-export-v1` 包无来源块时按本地处理。
219	- 轮换/导出/导入/恢复必须命中记录登记的 provider：记录属于未激活提供者，或
220	  导入/恢复来源块与当前提供者不符，均 `503`，不静默切换。
221	- 启动时安全扫描旧记录：仅当本地提供者活动时，把裸 `private_material`/空句
222	  柄的旧版本校验并包装为本地对象，先包装后原子重写，失败保持原文件字节不
223	  变（新建句柄随即释放，不影响启动）；配置了外部提供者时启动与普通读取既不
224	  加载提供者也不改写旧记录（此类记录在导出/轮换时 `503`）。
225	
226	## 持久化与限制
227	
228	- 每个密钥为数据目录下 `<key_id>.json`（0600，fsync + 原子 rename），含
229	  append-only `versions` 与 `current_version`；轮换在 per-key 进程内锁 +
230	  `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 锁下读改写，并发不丢版本、不悬指针。
231	- 导入/恢复/批量轮换在提供者调用前先建按 event_id 命名的 provision journal，
232	  每铸一个句柄即耐久登记；提交后句柄归记录所有并删除 journal，未提交（冲突、
233	  提供者故障、账本失败、崩溃）则幂等删除全部已铸句柄，不留孤儿后端对象。批量
234	  轮换另在 `batch-rotations/<event_id>.json` 耐久记录每个 key 轮换前的整文件
235	  字节（snapshot），未提交时据此把整组文件还原；snapshot 缺失则整组保留等待下
236	  次启动，绝不猜测改写。
237	- 旧 restore 记录可能没有 provision journal：未提交回滚时以 `_restore` 标记
238	  的密钥文件列出整组句柄；提供者不可达或任一句柄删除失败时，保留整组密钥文件、
239	  策略文件与标记，下一次启动重试，全部句柄确认删除后才移除整组文件。
240	- 私钥与口令只存在于口令加密的包内或经提供者包装后的记录中；游标 HMAC 密钥
241	  存于 `audit.secret`(0600)。材料不会出现在任何响应、审计投影或错误信息中。
242

# SOLOTASK01 多租户密钥管理后端

一个多租户密钥管理服务，同时提供 HTTP API 与命令行入口。支持 AES256 / RSA2048
密钥的生成、版本化轮换、吊销、加密导出/导入、租户级加密备份/恢复、按租户的
操作者策略、只追加的审计账，以及可插拔的 KMS/HSM 提供者。轮换/导入/恢复是
幂等变更：同一 `Idempotency-Key` 的重试只重放原结果，进程在任一步骤崩溃后
重启都能据 `operation_id` 判定是否已耐久并一致收尾。私钥只保存在服务端，
任何响应与审计投影都不含私钥、句柄或包装材料。

## 依赖与安装

Python 3.10+，仅一个运行时依赖：

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt   # cryptography>=3.4
```

## 启动

```bash
python -m keymgr --data-dir ./keymgr_data serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
```

数据目录也可用环境变量 `KEYMGR_DATA_DIR` 指定（CLI 默认 `keymgr_data`）。
提供者由 `KEYMGR_PROVIDER` 选择（缺省或 `local` 为内置本地提供者，其它值为
`module:factory`，首次使用时才惰性加载，绝不回退本地）。

## 基础测试

```bash
python -m compileall -q keymgr
python3 -c "from keymgr.crypto import generate_key; generate_key('AES256'); generate_key('RSA2048')"
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/keys \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"a","algorithm":"AES256","label":"t"}'
```

## 通用约定

- 除 `serve` 外每个请求都需单一非空头 `X-Operator-Id: <operator>`（CLI 为
  必填 `--operator`）；缺失/为空/重复均 `400`（CLI 退出 `2`）。操作者既是
  审计主体也是策略 `subject`。
- 租户来源：单一 `X-Tenant-Id` 头或单一 `?tenant_id=` 参数；允许 body 携带
  `tenant_id` 的端点，头/参数/体必须一致。缺失、重复、冲突均 `400` 且错误指
  `tenant_id`，并记一条任何租户都不可见的 `tenant_conflict` 事件（幂等端点在
  幂等键绑定**之前**的参数/解析错误例外：不写任何审计、操作、密钥或句柄）。
- 错误 HTTP 状态与 CLI 退出码：`400→2`、`403→3`、`409→3`、`404→4`、
  `500/503→1`；成功 `0`。普通错误体仅 `{"error": ...}`；幂等变更的错误体仅
  `{"error", "operation_id"}`，成功体额外含 `operation_id`。
- `key_id` 为小写 UUID4，非法值是 `400`；未知对象与跨租户访问统一 `404`，
  不泄露存在性。

## HTTP 接口

- `POST /v1/keys`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm, label}`，`algorithm` 仅
  `AES256`/`RSA2048`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key}`（AES 的
  `public_key` 为 null，RSA 为 PEM）。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}` → `{algorithm, label, created_at, public_key}`。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key,
  operation_id}`，版本严格递增、只追加。
- `POST /v1/keys/batch-rotate`，body
  `{tenant_id, items:[{key_id, algorithm}, ...]}`，需 `Idempotency-Key`。
  `items` 限 1–100 项，`key_id` 为不重复小写 UUID4，`algorithm` 仅
  AES256/RSA2048；任一非法 `400` 且在幂等键绑定**之前**零副作用（不写审计、
  操作、密钥或句柄）。按 `rotate` 授权：策略拒绝 `403`；任一 `key_id` 未知
  或属于其它租户则整批 `404`（不泄露跨租户存在性），皆零变更。`201` →
  `{items:[{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key}, ...], operation_id}`，
  items 严格按请求序；各 key 沿用单键 rotate 语义，整批原子提交（共享一把
  per-key 锁顺序、单一 provision/snapshot 记账、单条提交事件）。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/versions/{version}` 与
  `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/current` →
  `{key_id, version, created_at, algorithm, public_key}`；version 须为正整数。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke`，body `{tenant_id, reason, operator}` →
  `{key_id, status, reason, operator, revoked_at}`；重复/并发吊销幂等，保留
  首次值。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/status`：字段同 revoke；active 时后三项为 null。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/export`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
  `{format:"keymgr-export-v1", bundle}`，bundle 为不透明 base64（scrypt +
  AES-256-GCM，`format` 作为 AAD）。
- `POST /v1/keys/import`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key, operation_id}`，
  保留原 key_id、全部版本、label、current 与吊销状态。同租户已有 key_id 为
  `409`，key_id 被其它租户占用为 `404`；口令/篡改/格式错误为 `400` 且不占用
  幂等键。
- `POST /v1/backup`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
  `{format:"tenant-backup-v1", bundle}`；载荷
  `{format, tenant_id, keys, policy}`，空租户为 `keys:[]、policy:null`。
- `POST /v1/restore`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。校验顺序：参数/解密/格式 `400` → 授权 `403` → 包内
  tenant 不符 `404` → 同租户 key_id/策略冲突 `409`（绝不覆盖既有策略）→
  多文件原子恢复 `201` → `{tenant_id, key_ids, policy_restored,
  operation_id}`。空包同样成功（`key_ids:[]`、`policy_restored:false`）。
- `GET /v1/policy` / `PUT /v1/policy` / `DELETE /v1/policy`：读/替换/删除
  租户策略，见下。
- `GET /v1/audit`：本租户审计查询，见下。
- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：查询幂等操作，见下。

## 幂等操作

- rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate（CLI：
  `rotate`/`import`/`restore`/`batch-rotate`）必须携带**单一**
  `Idempotency-Key` 头（CLI 必填 `--idempotency-key`），值为 1–128 个
  `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` 字符。缺失、为空、重复、非法一律 `400`（CLI `2`），且该
  校验先于请求体读取与一切业务：不写审计、操作记录、密钥或提供者句柄。
- 键全局唯一，绑定记录 `operation_id`(UUID4)、租户、操作者、路径、规范化体
  （键排序紧凑 JSON）、状态、HTTP 状态与响应；存于 `operations/<id>.json`
  (0600) 与 `operations/index.json`，进程内锁 + `operations.lock` 的 fcntl
  排他锁串行化。
- 相同绑定重试：直接重放首次状态码、响应体与审计事件（同一
  `operation_id`，业务不执行第二次）。同键不同绑定：`409`（CLI `3`），错误
  体给出已有 `operation_id`。绑定前的导入/恢复解密无副作用：口令错误 `400`
  不占用该键。
- 状态：`pending`/`succeeded`/`failed`/`conflict`/`timed_out`。成功为 `201`
  succeeded；同租户冲突为 `409` conflict；`403/404/400` 与提供者/账本失败为
  failed（保留原状态码）。并发同键仅一个执行，其余等待；等待超 5 秒返回
  `503` timed_out（CLI `1`），等待方不写任何东西。
- 多/单轮换互斥：批量轮换与单键 rotate 都按 `key_id` 排序获取 per-key
  进程内锁 + `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 排他锁（整批共享一个 5 秒截止时刻）。对同一
  key 的并发变更要么全在批量之前、要么全在之后；等待同一被占 key 超过 5 秒的
  批量返回 `503` timed_out 且零副作用（此时尚无 journal、事件或句柄）。
- `operation_id` 即该变更审计事件的 `event_id`，因此每个终态至多一条事件，
  HTTP 与 CLI 共用同一套记录，可跨入口用相同键重放或按 id 查询。
- **崩溃一致性**：进程可在绑定、outbox 落盘、账本追加或清理任一步骤崩溃。
  重启（或任一 CLI 入口）在 key/restore outbox 恢复之后，按同一
  `operation_id` 判定：事件已入帐即已提交，据耐久事实重建原 `201`/`403`/
  `404`/`409` 响应与审计投影并置终态（拒绝终态的状态码随事件持久化，严格
  重放）；事件未入帐则置 failed(`500`)，半成品文件、提供者句柄与标记由
  outbox/provision 恢复回滚。不重复记账（账本按 event_id 去重），不误判。
- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：需单一操作者与单一租户来源；操作须
  同时属于该租户与操作者，否则一律 `404`。`200` →
  `{operation_id, tenant_id, status, http_status, response}`，pending 时后两
  项为 null。CLI：`operation --tenant-id --operator --operation-id`。

## 策略

- `GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/policy`，租户由单一头或单一参数提供（PUT 也可由 body
  的 `tenant_id` 提供，来源须一致）。GET → `{tenant_id, rules}`（无策略
  `404`）；PUT body `{tenant_id, rules}` 整体替换；DELETE 幂等，→
  `{tenant_id, deleted:true}`。
- 规则元素 `{subject, actions, effect}`：`subject` 为区分大小写的非空字符串；
  `actions` 为非空数组，取值
  `create/read/rotate/revoke/import/export/audit`，单条内重复去重；`effect`
  为 `allow`/`deny`；未知字段、类型错误、同 subject+effect+无序动作集的重复
  规则均 `400`；`rules:[]` 合法（全拒绝）。
- 执行：管理动作 policy_* 免检；租户无策略时全部允许；有策略时匹配规则中
  deny 优先于 allow，无匹配则拒绝 → `403`，并记一条原动作名、
  `outcome=rejected`、携带当时已知 `key_id` 的事件（create/解密前的 import/
  audit 查询为 null）。参数校验先于授权，授权先于存在性判断。

## 审计

- 事件字段 `{event_id, tenant_id, action, key_id, outcome, timestamp}`；
  `action` 为 `create/read/rotate/batch_rotate/revoke/import/export/audit/
  tenant_conflict/policy_read/policy_update/policy_delete`，`outcome` 为
  `success/rejected`。备份记 `export`、恢复记 `import`，两者 `key_id` 均为
  null；恢复的所有事件（含成功）`key_id` 为 null；批量轮换整批至多一条
  `batch_rotate` 事件，成功与拒绝终态的 `key_id` 均为 null，可按
  `action=batch_rotate` 筛选。
- `GET /v1/audit`：单一租户来源；可选 `key_id`(UUID4)、`action`、
  `limit`(1–1000，默认 100)、`cursor`。→ `{events, next_cursor}`，按
  (timestamp, event_id) 升序；游标为 HMAC 签名令牌，绑定租户/筛选/快照，
  被篡改或条件变化为 `400`。查询成功不记账，被策略拒绝才记一条
  `audit/rejected`（key_id null）。
- 账本为数据目录 `audit.log`（每行一个 JSON，只追加，进程内锁 +
  `audit.log.lock` fcntl 串行并 fsync，seq 单调）。变更走 outbox 事务：密钥
  /策略文件先携带待提交事件原子落盘 → 耐久追加账本（提交点）→ 清标记；账本
  失败回滚文件并删除本次新建句柄，返回 `500`（CLI `1`）；崩溃后启动按标记/
  event_id 幂等补记或回滚，不重不漏。恢复是多文件 outbox（标记带
  `"_restore":true` 与写集清单），只追加一条 `import` 事件；批量轮换是多
  key outbox（标记带 `"_batch_rotate":true`、写集 key_ids 与 provision/
  snapshot 引用），只追加一条 `batch_rotate` 事件（`key_id` null）。

## 命令行

所有子命令除 `serve` 外都需 `--operator`，租户命令需 `--tenant-id`；输出为
单行 JSON，字段与对应 HTTP 响应一致。

```bash
# 密钥
python -m keymgr gen      --tenant-id t --algorithm RSA2048 --label k --operator alice
python -m keymgr show     --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
python -m keymgr current  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
python -m keymgr version  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --version 1 --operator alice
python -m keymgr rotate   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --algorithm AES256 \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key rotate-0001
python -m keymgr batch-rotate --tenant-id t --operator alice \
                          --idempotency-key batch-0001 \
                          --items '[{"key_id":"<id1>","algorithm":"AES256"},{"key_id":"<id2>","algorithm":"RSA2048"}]'
python -m keymgr revoke   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --reason r --operator alice
python -m keymgr status   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
# 导出/导入、备份/恢复
python -m keymgr export   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --passphrase pw --operator alice
python -m keymgr import   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key import-0001
python -m keymgr backup   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --operator alice
python -m keymgr restore  --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key restore-0001
# 审计 / 操作 / 策略
python -m keymgr audit    --tenant-id t --action rotate --limit 100 --operator alice
python -m keymgr operation --tenant-id t --operator alice --operation-id <id>
python -m keymgr policy --operator admin set|show|delete --tenant-id t [--rules '<json>']
```

## KMS/HSM 提供者

- 工厂返回对象须有非空 `provider_id`、`capabilities`
  （algorithms 含 AES256/RSA2048；operations 含
  generate/rotate/import_material/export_material/delete）及这五个方法。
  generate/rotate/import_material → `{handle, public_key, encrypted_material}`；
  export_material(handle) → `{public_key, encrypted_material}`；delete(handle)
  幂等。模块缺失/工厂失败/契约不符/后端异常一律 `503`（CLI `1`），固定文案
  "key management provider is unavailable"，绝不回退；导入材料不符算法（AES
  非 32 字节、RSA 公私钥不匹配等）为 `400`，错误只指名字段。
- 本地提供者用 `local.dek`(0600) 以 AES-256-GCM 包装材料，句柄与包装材料登
  记在 `local-registry.json`(0600)；密钥文件每个版本只存
  `{provider_id, handle, encrypted_material}` 三元组，导出包/备份包版本额外
  带 `provider` 来源块，旧 `keymgr-export-v1` 包无来源块时按本地处理。
- 轮换/导出/导入/恢复必须命中记录登记的 provider：记录属于未激活提供者，或
  导入/恢复来源块与当前提供者不符，均 `503`，不静默切换。
- 启动时安全扫描旧记录：仅当本地提供者活动时，把裸 `private_material`/空句
  柄的旧版本校验并包装为本地对象，先包装后原子重写，失败保持原文件字节不
  变（新建句柄随即释放，不影响启动）；配置了外部提供者时启动与普通读取既不
  加载提供者也不改写旧记录（此类记录在导出/轮换时 `503`）。

## 持久化与限制

- 每个密钥为数据目录下 `<key_id>.json`（0600，fsync + 原子 rename），含
  append-only `versions` 与 `current_version`；轮换在 per-key 进程内锁 +
  `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 锁下读改写，并发不丢版本、不悬指针。
- 导入/恢复/批量轮换在提供者调用前先建按 event_id 命名的 provision journal，
  每铸一个句柄即耐久登记；提交后句柄归记录所有并删除 journal，未提交（冲突、
  提供者故障、账本失败、崩溃）则幂等删除全部已铸句柄，不留孤儿后端对象。批量
  轮换另在 `batch-rotations/<event_id>.json` 耐久记录每个 key 轮换前的整文件
  字节（snapshot），未提交时据此把整组文件还原；snapshot 缺失则整组保留等待下
  次启动，绝不猜测改写。
- 旧 restore 记录可能没有 provision journal：未提交回滚时以 `_restore` 标记
  的密钥文件列出整组句柄；提供者不可达或任一句柄删除失败时，保留整组密钥文件、
  策略文件与标记，下一次启动重试，全部句柄确认删除后才移除整组文件。
- 私钥与口令只存在于口令加密的包内或经提供者包装后的记录中；游标 HMAC 密钥
  存于 `audit.secret`(0600)。材料不会出现在任何响应、审计投影或错误信息中。

300	class KeyStore:
301	    """File-backed key store with one JSON file per key."""
302	
303	    def __init__(self, data_dir: str, audit_log: Optional[AuditLog] = None) -> None:
304	        self.data_dir = data_dir
305	        os.makedirs(self.data_dir, exist_ok=True)
306	        # One lock per key_id serializes read-modify-write within a process.
307	        self._locks_lock = threading.Lock()
308	        self._locks: dict = {}
309	        self.audit = audit_log if audit_log is not None else AuditLog(data_dir)
310	        # Remember the data directory without importing a module:factory
311	        # provider or creating local provider state. A module:factory
312	        # provider loads lazily on its first operation, and a pre-provider
313	        # record is taken over by the local provider lazily on the first
314	        # export/backup that needs its material (and never while a non-local
315	        # provider is active).
316	        provider_mod.bind_data_dir(self.data_dir)
317	        # First finish/roll back interrupted single-key outbox transactions
318	        # (their resolution keeps the key's handles and drops the journal) ...
319	        self._recover_pending_events()
320	        # ... resolve multi-key batch-rotation groups (commit-point event
321	        # durable -> keep and clear markers; otherwise roll every file of the
322	        # group back only after every minted handle was deleted) ...
323	        self._recover_batch_rotations()
324	        # ... then take over raw pre-provider records once, at startup, while
325	        # the local provider is active (a plain file scan; an external
326	        # module:factory provider is never imported or configured here) ...
327	        self._migrate_legacy_records()
328	        # ... then delete handles provisioned by attempts that died before
329	        # their commit point (their audit event never reached the ledger and
330	        # no pending marker references it). Multi-file restore groups are
331	        # resolved later by the RestoreCoordinator, which reaps their
332	        # journals itself.
333	        self._recover_provisions()
334	
335	    # -- provider helpers --------------------------------------------------
336	    @staticmethod
337	    def _provider():
338	        """The active KMS/HSM provider (imported lazily on first use)."""
339	        return provider_mod.get_provider()
340	
341	    # -- provision journal -------------------------------------------------
342	    # An import/restore attempt mints provider objects (handles) *before* its
343	    # conflict recheck, file writes and the durable audit append. The journal
344	    # records every minted handle as it appears and is removed only after the
345	    # attempt finishes (commit or clean rollback). A process killed in between
346	    # is cleaned up at the next open: handles whose committing audit event is
347	    # in the ledger stay; every other handle is deleted, idempotently.
348	    _PROVISION_DIR = "provisions"
349	
350	    def _provision_path(self, journal_id: str) -> str:
351	        return os.path.join(
352	            self.data_dir, self._PROVISION_DIR, journal_id + ".json"
353	        )
354	
355	    def _new_provision_journal(self, journal_id: str):
356	        """Create one journal file for an import/restore attempt.
357	
358	        The journal is named after the attempt's audit ``event_id``: a
359	        leftover journal can then be resolved at any startup by asking the
360	        ledger whether that event committed — committed means keep every
361	        handle, otherwise delete them. Returns (journal_id, path). A crash
362	        before the journal exists simply means no handles were recorded yet.
363	        """
364	        directory = os.path.join(self.data_dir, self._PROVISION_DIR)
365	        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
366	        path = self._provision_path(journal_id)
367	        fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
368	        os.close(fd)
369	        return journal_id, path
370	
371	    def _append_provision(self, path: str, provider_id: str, handle: str) -> None:
372	        """Durably record one minted handle in an attempt's journal."""
373	        entry = {"provider_id": provider_id, "handle": handle}
374	        line = json.dumps(entry, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
375	        with open(path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
376	            fh.write(line)
377	            fh.flush()
378	            os.fsync(fh.fileno())

380	    def _discard_provision_journal(self, path: str) -> bool:
381	        """Drop an attempt's journal after it committed or rolled back.
382	
383	        Returns True when the journal is gone (including an already-absent
384	        one); a removal failure leaves the journal in place for the next
385	        open's recovery sweep instead of being silently swallowed.
386	        """
387	        try:
388	            os.unlink(path)
389	            return True
390	        except FileNotFoundError:
391	            return True
392	        except OSError:
393	            return False
394	
395	    def _delete_provisioned_handle(self, provider_id: str, handle: str) -> bool:
396	        """Delete one uncommitted handle. Returns True on success.
397	
398	        A cleanup failure is never silently swallowed: False keeps the
399	        attempt's provision journal on disk so the next open retries the
400	        delete. Crash cleanup may need the local backend before any request
401	        configured it (this never imports an external module:factory
402	        provider); a missing/inactive provider whose handle cannot be reached
403	        is likewise reported, not hidden.
404	        """
405	        if provider_id == LOCAL_PROVIDER_ID:
406	            try:
407	                provider_mod.configure_local(self.data_dir)
408	            except ProviderUnavailable:
409	                return False
410	        try:
411	            provider = self._provider_for(provider_id)
412	        except ProviderUnavailable:
413	            return False
414	        try:
415	            provider.delete(handle)
416	        except Exception:
417	            return False
418	        return True

420	    def _restore_marker_journals(self) -> set:
421	        """Journal ids referenced by still-present outbox markers.
422	
423	        A multi-file restore transaction is resolved by the
424	        RestoreCoordinator and a multi-key batch-rotation group by
425	        _recover_batch_rotations; their journals must not be reaped here even
426	        if its shared event is not in the ledger yet (the coordinator/group
427	        recovery either commits and keeps the handles, or rolls the whole
428	        group back and deletes them). A single-key rotate/import marker
429	        carrying a journal is deferred as well whenever its ledger append
430	        could not be settled earlier in this same open: deleting its handles
431	        before the event is durable would orphan the record the next open
432	        commits. Markers can live on a key file or, for a policy-only restore,
433	        in the policies directory.
434	        """
435	        referenced = set()
436	
437	        def consider(marker) -> None:
438	            if not isinstance(marker, dict):
439	                return
440	            journal_id = marker.get("journal")
441	            if isinstance(journal_id, str) and journal_id:
442	                referenced.add(journal_id)
443	
444	        try:
445	            names = os.listdir(self.data_dir)
446	        except OSError:
447	            names = []
448	        for name in names:
449	            if name.endswith(".json") and is_valid_key_id(name[:-5]):
450	                record = self._read_record(os.path.join(self.data_dir, name))
451	                if record is not None:
452	                    consider(record.pending_event)
453	        policy_dir = os.path.join(self.data_dir, "policies")
454	        try:
455	            policy_names = os.listdir(policy_dir)
456	        except OSError:
457	            policy_names = []
458	        for name in policy_names:
459	            if not name.endswith(".json"):
460	                continue
461	            try:
462	                with open(
463	                    os.path.join(policy_dir, name), "r", encoding="utf-8"
464	                ) as fh:
465	                    doc = json.load(fh)
466	            except (OSError, ValueError):
467	                continue
468	            if isinstance(doc, dict):
469	                consider(doc.get("pending_event"))
470	        return referenced
471	
472	    def _rollback_provision_entries(self, entries) -> bool:
473	        """Delete handles recorded by an uncommitted attempt.
474	
475	        Returns True only when every handle was deleted (or its provider
476	        cannot be reached but is not local — see _delete_provisioned_handle);
477	        a single failed delete means False and the journal must be retained
478	        for a retry on the next open. Deletes stay idempotent.
479	        """
480	        cleaned = True
481	        for provider_id, handle in entries:
482	            if not self._delete_provisioned_handle(provider_id, handle):
483	                cleaned = False
484	        return cleaned

486	    def _recover_provisions(self) -> None:
487	        """Settle provision journals left by attempts that did not finish.
488	
489	        Resolution is driven purely by the ledger event named after the
490	        journal (the operation/event id):
491	
492	        * a durable ``success`` event is the commit point -- the minted
493	          handles are now owned by the records and stay, the journal is
494	          removed;
495	        * no event, or a durable ``rejected`` event (a bound provider-failure
496	          terminal), means the attempt never owned the handles -- every
497	          recorded handle is deleted idempotently and the journal is removed
498	          only once every delete succeeds;
499	        * an unreadable ledger, a non-UUID journal or a failed handle delete
500	          leaves everything in place for the next open.
501	
502	        Journals still referenced by a restore marker are deferred to the
503	        RestoreCoordinator. Nothing here imports a provider when there are no
504	        handles to reap, so opening a store for plain reads stays
505	        provider-free.
506	        """
507	        deferred = (
508	            self._restore_marker_journals()
509	            | self.batch_recovery_journal_ids()
510	        )
511	        directory = os.path.join(self.data_dir, self._PROVISION_DIR)
512	        try:
513	            names = os.listdir(directory)
514	        except OSError:
515	            return
516	        for name in names:
517	            if not name.endswith(".json"):
518	                continue
519	            journal_id = name[:-5]
520	            if journal_id in deferred:
521	                continue
522	            path = os.path.join(directory, name)
523	            try:
524	                with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
525	                    lines = fh.readlines()
526	            except OSError:
527	                continue
528	            entries = []
529	            for line in lines:
530	                line = line.strip()
531	                if not line:
532	                    continue
533	                try:
534	                    entry = json.loads(line)
535	                except ValueError:
536	                    continue
537	                if not isinstance(entry, dict):
538	                    continue
539	                provider_id = entry.get("provider_id")
540	                handle = entry.get("handle")
541	                if isinstance(provider_id, str) and provider_id and isinstance(
542	                    handle, str
543	                ) and handle:
544	                    entries.append((provider_id, handle))
545	            try:
546	                is_uuid4 = uuid.UUID(journal_id).version == 4
547	            except (ValueError, AttributeError):
548	                # An unidentifiable journal can never be resolved against an
549	                # event: leave it for manual/operator resolution rather than
550	                # deleting possibly-committed material.
551	                continue
552	            if not is_uuid4:
553	                continue
554	            event = None
555	            try:
556	                event = self.audit.get_event(journal_id)
557	            except LedgerError:
558	                # Cannot decide right now; leave the whole journal for a
559	                # later open rather than deleting committed material.
560	                continue
561	            if event is not None and event.outcome == audit_mod.OUTCOME_SUCCESS:
562	                # Committed: handles belong to the durable records; housekeep
563	                # the journal. A failed unlink simply retries on next open.
564	                self._discard_provision_journal(path)
565	                continue
566	            # Event absent (crash/rollback) or a durable rejected terminal:
567	            # the attempt never owned the handles. Retain the journal until
568	            # every handle delete actually succeeds.
569	            if self._rollback_provision_entries(entries):
570	                self._discard_provision_journal(path)
571	
572	    def drop_provision_journal(self, journal_id: str) -> bool:
573	        """Remove an attempt journal after it committed or fully rolled back.
574	
575	        Returns True when no journal remains. A failed unlink keeps it for
576	        startup recovery.
577	        """
578	        if not journal_id:
579	            return True
580	        return self._discard_provision_journal(self._provision_path(journal_id))
581	
582	    def rollback_provision_journal(self, journal_id: str) -> bool:
583	        """Delete every handle an uncommitted attempt journaled, then drop it.
584	
585	        Used by the request path when an import/rotate/restore aborts before
586	        its commit point (provider fault, refused conflict, ledger failure).
587	        The journal is removed only once every recorded handle has been
588	        deleted; a failed backend delete retains it so the next open retries
589	        — cleanup failures are reported, never swallowed. Idempotent.
590	        """
591	        if not journal_id:
592	            return True
593	        entries = self.read_provision_journal(journal_id)
594	        if not self._rollback_provision_entries(entries):
595	            return False
596	        return self.drop_provision_journal(journal_id)

598	    def _abort_provision(self, journal_id: str, adopted=()) -> None:
599	        """Scrub handles of an aborted attempt and reconcile its journal.
600	
601	        Deletes the still-known ``(provider, handle)`` pairs directly and then
602	        the durable journal (which covers handles whose entries were recorded
603	        but whose in-memory pair the aborting frame no longer holds); deletes
604	        are idempotent. Raises ProviderUnavailable when any delete cannot be
605	        verified -- the journal then stays on disk and startup retries -- so a
606	        cleanup failure is a 503, never a silent orphan.
607	        """
608	        cleaned = self._release_handles(adopted)
609	        if not self.rollback_provision_journal(journal_id):
610	            cleaned = False
611	        if not cleaned:
612	            raise ProviderUnavailable(
613	                "could not delete a handle provisioned by an aborted attempt; "
614	                "cleanup will be retried at startup"
615	            )

617	    def read_provision_journal(self, journal_id: str) -> list:
618	        """Return the (provider_id, handle) pairs an attempt journal holds."""
619	        if not journal_id:
620	            return []
621	        path = self._provision_path(journal_id)
622	        entries = []
623	        try:
624	            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
625	                lines = fh.readlines()
626	        except OSError:
627	            return []
628	        for line in lines:
629	            line = line.strip()
630	            if not line:
631	                continue
632	            try:
633	                entry = json.loads(line)
634	            except ValueError:
635	                continue
636	            provider_id = entry.get("provider_id")
637	            handle = entry.get("handle")
638	            if isinstance(provider_id, str) and provider_id and isinstance(
639	                handle, str
640	            ) and handle:
641	                entries.append((provider_id, handle))

644	    def release_journal_handles(self, journal_id: str) -> bool:

647	        Returns True only when every delete succeeded.
648	        """
649	        return self._rollback_provision_entries(

653	    def _migrate_legacy_records(self) -> None:
654	        """Startup sweep adopting raw pre-provider records into local.
655	
656	        Runs only while the built-in local provider is active. With a
657	        module:factory provider configured the sweep does nothing: it never
658	        imports that provider or rewrites a local-owned record (the record is
659	        refused 503 by the owning-provider gates instead, with no fallback).
660	        Only files that genuinely hold a raw legacy version are opened with
661	        the provider, so a data directory of modern records creates no DEK or
662	        registry and loads no provider on startup -- plain reads stay
663	        provider-free.
664	
665	        Every candidate is adopted under its per-key locks: each raw version
666	        is validated and wrapped by the local provider, then the file is
667	        rewritten once atomically so the plaintext field disappears. A
668	        validation or write failure leaves the original file byte-for-byte
669	        intact (the just-minted handles are released) and never aborts
670	        startup; the record can be retried by a later export/backup.
671	        """
672	        if not provider_mod.active_is_local():
673	            return
674	        try:
675	            names = os.listdir(self.data_dir)
676	        except OSError:
677	            return
678	        for name in names:
679	            if not (name.endswith(".json") and is_valid_key_id(name[:-5])):
680	                continue
681	            key_id = name[:-5]
682	            path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, name)
683	            # One provider-free peek: only a record that actually carries a
684	            # raw legacy version proceeds to wrapping.
685	            record = self._read_record(path)
686	            if record is None or not any(
687	                ver.provider_id == LOCAL_PROVIDER_ID and not ver.handle
688	                for ver in record.versions
689	            ):
690	                continue
691	            try:
692	                with self._key_lock(key_id), self._file_lock(key_id):
693	                    # Re-read under the locks: another process may have
694	                    # adopted the record since the unlocked directory scan.
695	                    locked = self._read_record(path)
696	                    if locked is None:
697	                        continue
698	                    self._take_over_legacy(locked)
699	            except Exception:
700	                # The original file is untouched and any minted handles were
701	                # already released inside _take_over_legacy; skip this
702	                # record rather than failing startup.
703	                continue
704	
705	    def _take_over_legacy(self, record: KeyRecord) -> None:
706	        """Adopt raw pre-provider versions into the local provider.
707	
708	        Callers hold the key's in-process and cross-process locks. Only runs
709	        while the local provider is the active provider; a legacy version
710	        touched while a module:factory provider is active is refused by
711	        :meth:`_provider_for` instead (503) and nothing is rewritten. Every
712	        version is validated and wrapped *before* the file is rewritten once,
713	        atomically: if validation or the write fails the original file stays
714	        byte-for-byte intact and the handles just minted are released.
715	        """
716	        if not provider_mod.active_is_local():
717	            return
718	        if isinstance(record.pending_event, dict) and record.pending_event:
719	            # A read/backup must never rewrite a file whose transaction is
720	            # unresolved (event not durable): the trimmed committed view is a
721	            # projection only, and a rewrite would discard the recovery
722	            # scene. Committed markers (event durable) are safe.
723	            if not self._marker_event_durable(record.pending_event):
724	                return
725	        local = provider_mod.configure_local(self.data_dir)
726	        adopted = []
727	        new_versions = []
728	        changed = False
729	        try:
730	            for ver in record.versions:
731	                if (
732	                    ver.provider_id == LOCAL_PROVIDER_ID
733	                    and not ver.handle
734	                ):
735	                    triple = local.import_material(
736	                        ver.algorithm,
737	                        ver.public_key,
738	                        ver.encrypted_material,
739	                    )
740	                    adopted.append(triple.handle)
741	                    new_versions.append(
742	                        (
743	                            ver,
744	                            triple.handle,
745	                            triple.encrypted_material,
746	                            triple.public_key,
747	                        )
748	                    )
749	                    changed = True
750	            if not changed:
751	                return
752	            for ver, handle, material, public_key in new_versions:
753	                ver.handle = handle
754	                ver.encrypted_material = material
755	                if ver.public_key is None:
756	                    ver.public_key = public_key
757	            self._write_atomic(
758	                self._path_for(record.key_id), record.to_json()
759	            )
760	        except BaseException:
761	            # Validation failed or the atomic rewrite did not land: the
762	            # original file is untouched. Release the registry entries this
763	            # takeover just minted so the local backend leaks nothing.
764	            for handle in adopted:
765	                try:
766	                    local.delete(handle)
767	                except Exception:
768	                    pass
769	            raise

771	    # -- audit bookkeeping -------------------------------------------------
772	    def audit_conflict(self) -> None:
773	        """Record an invisible tenant_conflict event (both ids null)."""
774	        self.audit.append(
775	            self.audit.new_event(

871	    def _commit_mutation(
872	        self,
873	        path: str,
874	        record: KeyRecord,
875	        event: AuditEvent,
876	        previous: Optional[dict],
877	        provider=None,
878	        new_handles=(),
879	        journal_id: Optional[str] = None,
880	        pre_commit=None,
881	    ) -> None:
882	        """Commit a key-file change and its event as one logical transaction.
883	
884	        The record is first written carrying the pending event (an outbox
885	        marker), the event is then appended durably to the ledger, and the
886	        marker is cleared in a second atomic write. If the ledger append
887	        fails the key file is rolled back (deleted for a brand-new key whose
888	        ``previous`` is None, restored to its prior bytes otherwise), and any
889	        provider handles the change minted are deleted, so a failed ledger
890	        write leaves neither a single-sided file nor an orphaned HSM object.
891	        ``journal_id`` (import only) is folded into the marker so crash
892	        recovery can drop the attempt's provision journal after resolving it.
893	        ``pre_commit`` (when given) runs strictly between the durable marker
894	        write and the ledger append: it lets the caller durably persist the
895	        idempotent operation's terminal context so the response can be
896	        replayed verbatim once the event lands; an exception rolls the file
897	        and handles back exactly like a failed ledger append. A crash at any
898	        point is repaired idempotently by _recover_pending_events on the next
899	        open.
900	        """
901	        marker = event.to_json()
902	        if journal_id:
903	            marker = dict(marker)
904	            marker["journal"] = journal_id
905	        record.pending_event = marker
906	
907	        def release_handles() -> bool:
908	            # Returns False when a minted handle could not be deleted: the
909	            # caller must surface that (503) instead of hiding an orphaned
910	            # backend object.
911	            if provider is None:
912	                return True
913	            cleaned = True
914	            for handle in new_handles:
915	                try:
916	                    provider.delete(handle)
917	                except Exception:
918	                    cleaned = False
919	            return cleaned
920	
921	        try:
922	            self._write_atomic(path, record.to_json())
923	            if pre_commit is not None:
924	                # The in-memory record already carries the version being
925	                # committed, so the caller can stage the exact 201 response
926	                # before the commit-point append.
927	                pre_commit(record)
928	            self.audit.append(event)
929	        except BaseException as exc:
930	            # Only roll the file back when it may have landed: a failure of
931	            # the ledger append, or of the initial write after a partial file.
932	            if os.path.exists(path):
933	                if previous is None:
934	                    try:
935	                        os.unlink(path)
936	                    except OSError:
937	                        pass
938	                else:
939	                    try:
940	                        self._write_atomic(path, previous)
941	                    except Exception:
942	                        pass
943	            if not release_handles():
944	                # The file is rolled back but a backend object survives:
945	                # report a provider failure (503, generic client message);
946	                # callers keep/retry the provision journal so startup
947	                # eventually deletes the handle.
948	                raise ProviderUnavailable(
949	                    "rollback could not delete a provisioned provider handle"
950	                ) from exc
951	            raise
952	        # The durable ledger append is the commit point: the change and its
953	        # event are now authoritative and must never be rolled back. Clearing
954	        # the marker is best-effort housekeeping; a failure here (or a crash)
955	        # is repaired on the next open and must not surface as a failed
956	        # request or trigger handle deletion.
957	        record.pending_event = None
958	        try:
959	            self._write_atomic(path, record.to_json())
960	        except OSError:
961	            pass

977	    @contextmanager
978	    def _timed_inproc(self, key_id: str, deadline) -> Iterator[None]:
979	        """Acquire the per-key in-process lock against a shared deadline."""
980	        inproc = self._key_lock(key_id)
981	        remaining = max(deadline - time.monotonic(), 0.0)
982	        if not inproc.acquire(timeout=remaining):
983	            raise LockTimeout(key_id)
984	        try:
985	            yield
986	        finally:
987	            inproc.release()

989	    @contextmanager
990	    def _file_lock(self, key_id: str, deadline=None) -> Iterator[None]:
991	        """Cross-process advisory lock guarding mutation of a single key.
992	
993	        The in-process lock is taken separately by callers. With ``deadline``
994	        (a monotonic deadline) the fcntl lock is acquired non-blocking with
995	        polling and :class:`LockTimeout` is raised when the deadline passes;
996	        otherwise this blocks until acquired, the historical behavior.
997	        """
998	        lock_path = self._lock_path_for(key_id)
999	        if fcntl is None:  # pragma: no cover - non-POSIX platforms
1000	            yield
1001	            return
1002	        fd = os.open(lock_path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT, 0o600)
1003	        acquired = False
1004	        try:
1005	            if deadline is None:
1006	                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
1007	            else:
1008	                while True:
1009	                    try:
1010	                        fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
1011	                        break
1012	                    except BlockingIOError:
1013	                        remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
1014	                        if remaining <= 0:
1015	                            raise LockTimeout(key_id)
1016	                        time.sleep(min(0.02, remaining))
1017	            acquired = True
1018	            yield
1019	        finally:
1020	            if acquired:
1021	                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
1022	            os.close(fd)

1154	    def _marker_event_durable(self, marker) -> bool:

1166	            return False
1167	        nested = marker.get("event")
1168	        desc = nested if isinstance(nested, dict) else marker
1169	        event_id = desc.get("event_id") if isinstance(desc, dict) else None
1170	        if not isinstance(event_id, str) or not event_id:
1171	            return False

1173	            event = self.audit.get_event(event_id)

1181	    def _committed_record(
1182	        self, record: KeyRecord
1183	    ) -> Optional[KeyRecord]:
1184	        """Project only the durable state of a file read from disk.
1185	
1186	        A key file can carry an outbox pending marker while a transaction is
1187	        in flight or because the process crashed before recovery settled it.
1188	        A marker whose event is already in the ledger is effectively
1189	        committed (only marker-clear housekeeping remains) and is shown. A
1190	        marker whose event is NOT durable hides its uncommitted change:
1191	
1192	        * a rotate/batch-rotate appends one new version: that trailing
1193	          version and the advanced ``current_version`` are stripped, so no
1194	          uncommitted current, handle or material is ever projected; if no
1195	          committed version remains the key is hidden entirely;
1196	        * create/import write a brand-new file and restore writes brand-new
1197	          key files: an uncommitted one is hidden entirely.
1198	
1199	        The ledger being unreadable is treated conservatively as
1200	        "not durable", so an outage can never expose an uncommitted current.
1201	        The passed object is freshly parsed from one file read and is local
1202	        to the caller, so mutating its view never touches disk.
1203	        """
1204	        marker = record.pending_event
1205	        if not isinstance(marker, dict) or not marker:
1206	            return record
1207	        if self._marker_event_durable(marker):
1208	            return record
1209	        nested = marker.get("event")
1210	        desc = nested if isinstance(nested, dict) else marker
1211	        if marker.get("_restore"):
1212	            # A restore only ever creates brand-new key files; an
1213	            # uncommitted one (rolled back, or parked pending recovery) must
1214	            # not become visible.
1215	            return None
1216	        action = desc.get("action") if isinstance(desc, dict) else None
1217	        if action in (
1218	            audit_mod.ACTION_ROTATE,
1219	            audit_mod.ACTION_BATCH_ROTATE,
1220	        ):
1221	            if len(record.versions) <= 1:
1222	                return None
1223	            record.versions = record.versions[:-1]
1224	            record.current_version = record.versions[-1].version
1225	            return record
1226	        if action == audit_mod.ACTION_REVOKE:
1227	            # A pending revoke marker is always a first-time active->revoked
1228	            # transition (an idempotent repeat revoke appends without a
1229	            # marker), and it adds no version: its pre-image is this same
1230	            # record while still active. Project that rather than hiding an
1231	            # existing key or showing uncommitted revocation state.
1232	            record.status = "active"
1233	            record.reason = None
1234	            record.operator = None
1235	            record.revoked_at = None

1237	        # create/import new files and any unrecognized marker shape: the
1238	        # safe projection is "not here".
